title: LLaVA (Large Language and Vision Assistant)
reading: The slide introduces LLaVA, a large language and vision assistant that leverages the autoregressive nature of large language models. Its training approach is visual instruction tuning, which relies on a large amount of <visual, question, answer> triples. A citation to Liu et al., Visual Instruction Tuning, NeurIPS 2023 is given as the source.

concepts.name: LLaVA
concepts.why_it_matters: A canonical multimodal assistant combining a vision encoder with an LLM.

concepts.name: Visual instruction tuning
concepts.why_it_matters: The training recipe that aligns visual inputs with instruction-following LLM behaviour.

concepts.name: Autoregressive language modelling
concepts.why_it_matters: The generation mechanism LLaVA inherits from its LLM backbone.
